text:
I am writing to inquire about hiring the Brightwater for a weekend getaway. We plan to collect it from your garage on 27th August 2027 at 11am and return it on Sun 29 Aug 2027 at 18:00. It would be ideal if it could be provided with a picnic hamper, as per your website, which indicates the total cost will be EUR 1,427.80. I have attached my driving licence for your reference.

Best regards,
Jasper Wintermere
+70 642 983 4643
